answer.title: Automate Visit Rescheduling
answer.trigger: A customer submits a helpdesk ticket requesting to reschedule their visit.
steps: Read the incoming helpdesk ticket to find the customer name and requested new visit time.
Search for the existing booking in the jobs system.
Update the booking date and time in the jobs system.
Draft a reply in the helpdesk confirming the new schedule for human review.
answer.ai_help: Extracts the requested date and time from the ticket text and matches it to the correct customer in the jobs system.
answer.human_approval: Claire must approve the updated booking time and the reply sent to the customer.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation picks the wrong booking or time, the service visit will happen at the wrong time.
